title: Turn the two hand-run sweeps into a standing scan-set hygiene suite
action: Write a NEW suite scripts/tests/test_scan_set_hygiene.mjs, registered in scripts/run_verify.mjs, carrying two checks that were previously run by hand exactly once each. (E4) Flag any file under scripts/tests/** and packages/bee/** that derives a path list from `git ls-files` and later reads those paths via readFileSync/statSync/readFile with no intervening existence filter. This exact defect crashed test_doctrine_parity.mjs on ENOENT -- taking every assertion behind it into silence, which is strictly worse than a failure -- and it still sat live in test_portable_paths.mjs until dch-4. Known-good shapes to allow: an existsSync filter on the list, or a per-item existsSync guard before the read (see test_installers_e2e.mjs:191-199). (E8) Assert the completeness criterion the previous feature could not keep: no live file describes a retired workflow stage as current behavior. Exception set, exactly: docs/decisions/**, docs/history/**, and the legacy-coercion code path. Derive what counts as a retired stage from the phase enum rather than hardcoding a name, so the check survives the next removal. Both checks must be GREEN against the repo as it stands after dch-4 and dch-7 land -- that is why this cell depends on them. A new gate that ships red teaches everyone to ignore it.

truths: The suite is registered in run_verify.mjs and runs in the full chain
A file reading a git ls-files list without an existence guard makes it fail, naming that file
A live file describing a retired stage as current makes it fail, naming that file
The exception set is exactly docs/decisions, docs/history and the coercion path

artifacts.substantive: both checks with named-offender failure messages

key_links: the retired-stage check derives the stage name from the phase enum, never a hardcoded literal
prohibitions: No widening of the exception set to make the check pass

verify: node scripts/tests/test_scan_set_hygiene.mjs && node scripts/tests/test_doctrine_parity.mjs && node scripts/tests/test_portable_paths.mjs

trace.outcome: Added scripts/tests/test_scan_set_hygiene.mjs, a new standing suite carrying the two hand-run E4/E8 sweeps: check 1 flags a git-ls-files-derived scan set read from disk with no existsSync guard in its enclosing function (scoped to scripts/tests/** and packages/bee/**); check 2 flags a live current-behavior file (skills/**/SKILL.md, skills/**/references/**, docs/knowledge/**, docs/specs/**, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md) describing a retired workflow stage as current, deriving the retired token(s) from state.mjs's LEGACY_PHASE_COERCIONS rather than a hardcoded name. Both checks proved on synthetic --selftest fixtures plus a live temporary-injection-and-restore against the real tree (scratch file for check 1, a real routing-and-contracts.md append for check 2), each correctly naming the offending file. Registers via run_verify.mjs's existing test_*.mjs glob discovery -- run_verify.mjs untouched. Full verify (this suite + test_doctrine_parity.mjs + test_portable_paths.mjs) green.
